rationale: The agent verified identity via the user’s email matched to a single account, reviewed the user’s orders with read-only tools, identified the correct delivered order containing the earbuds, and checked product variants and availability. It stated the exact change (blue 8h IPX4 to black 4h not resistant), presented the price difference ($16.85) and payment method (PayPal), and obtained explicit confirmation before performing the exchange. The exchange was executed using the correct tool with the right item IDs and order, and the resulting status and price difference matched tool output. Final information provided was consistent with the tools and policy. No actions were taken without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported claims affected the outcome.
